visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair tied back, wearing a light grey polo shirt, sits in a well-lit indoor room. She speaks directly to the camera with expressive eyes and a friendly smile, holding a small white Cinnamoroll hair accessory. The background is a blurry white wall with soft overhead lighting. (2) The scene transitions to a montage of older, slightly lower-quality photos and video clips. She is seen at a themed amusement park, wearing a giant white Cinnamoroll plush hat. She stands in a colorful gift shop, looking at items with a mix of longing and hesitation. (3) The footage cuts to the present day inside a brightly colored, themed restaurant. The woman sits before an elaborate meal shaped like a white puppy character. She becomes visibly emotional, covering her eyes with her hand as tears well up, while still maintaining a grateful smile. (4) Back in the indoor room, she continues her monologue. Her facial expressions are encouraging and empathetic as she gestures toward her heart. The lighting is natural and soft, illuminating her face clearly against the minimalist white and grey background of the bedroom. (5) A fast-paced montage shows her joyfully eating the themed food and laughing with friends at the park. The final shot is a close-up selfie where she beams at the camera while hugging a massive white Cinnamoroll plushie, filling the frame with her happy expression.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 你也曾經只敢買一個髮夾. (2) [Subtitle]: 卻偷偷夢想整個樂園嗎？ (3) [Subtitle]: 7年前我選上了旅遊活動徵選. (4) [Subtitle]: 很幸運有機會無酬去日本拍攝一個月. (5) [Subtitle]: 但當時後銀行戶頭只剩下1萬多. (6) [Slogan]: 身為大耳狗鐵粉的我. (7) [Subtitle]: 也是我第一次踏進東京的三麗鷗樂園. (8) [Subtitle]: 門票是免費的我卻連午餐都買不起. (9) [Subtitle]: 當時我在商店繞了很久. (10) [Subtitle]: 最後硬著頭皮買了一個小小的髮夾. (11) [Subtitle]: 那是我能負擔的全部. (12) [Subtitle]: 也是我當時對生活最大限度的溫柔. (13) [Subtitle]: 7年後我再次踏進了這座樂園. (14) [Subtitle]: 終於可以買得起我喜歡的周邊紀念品. (15) [Subtitle]: 這一次，手上端著. (16) [Slogan]: 不用看價格の大耳狗套餐. (17) [Subtitle]: 站在原地，眼淚直接掉下來. (18) [Subtitle]: 不是因為食物特別好吃. (19) [Subtitle]: 是因為我終於可以好好對待自己了. (20) [Subtitle]: 有些果實需要時間成熟. (21) [Subtitle]: 有些夢想不會立刻兌現. (22) [Subtitle]: 只要你持續做對的事它們會一直記得你. (23) [Subtitle]: 慢慢地穩穩地悄悄地靠近你. (24) [Subtitle]: 如果你現在還在撐著、忍著、選擇便宜的那一個. (25) [Subtitle]: 跟我當時一樣. (26) [Subtitle]: 請你相信未來的某一天. (27) [Subtitle]: 你也能毫不猶豫地款待自己.
